hideMode.label: Hide mode
hideMode.desc: When the taskbar has no windows or pinned apps.

onlySameOutput.label: Only same monitor
onlySameOutput.desc: Show only windows on this bar's monitor.

onlyActiveWorkspaces.label: Only active workspaces
onlyActiveWorkspaces.desc: Show only windows on currently active workspaces.

colorizeIcons.label: Colorize icons
colorizeIcons.desc: Apply theme colorization to app icons.

showPinnedApps.label: Show pinned apps
showPinnedApps.desc: Show pinned apps even when they are not running.

iconScale.label: Icon scale
iconScale.desc: Scale of taskbar app icons relative to capsule height.

showTitle.label: Show title
showTitle.desc: Show window titles next to icons (horizontal bar only).
showTitle.descDisabled: Titles are disabled on vertical bars.

titleWidth.label: Title width
titleWidth.desc: Maximum width of each window title in pixels.

smartWidth.label: Smart width
smartWidth.desc: Shrink titles so the taskbar stays within a max width.

maxTaskbarWidth.label: Max taskbar width
maxTaskbarWidth.desc: Maximum width of the taskbar as a percent of screen width.
